limits: Single association, not a paired experiment or proof of Air sleep/wake repair.
Scan requests and API call intervals do not measure RF dwell; zero observed records do not prove absence.
PS events are host notifications. Emitted kernel continuity does not restore rate-limited events or prove final wake latency.
Global P/F sequence gaps exclude other peers before target filtering; unobserved boundary events remain unknown.
BATRACE is observed frame/preparation logging and BAMCU is command return; neither proves delivery or operational BA. No aggregate-status inference is made.
Server TCP and client intervals have separate relative starts and rounding; retransmits are not a wire-loss counter.

Single-6GHz AP/SSID, frequency and non-MLO mask are verified before traffic; the same target/AP association persists in station.after and router configuration is unchanged. No after queue/WCID/mask or AP-info snapshot exists.
MLO-only P/F tracing does not cover this non-MLO station. Queue PS snapshots are instantaneous host state, not transition durations or a wake-latency measurement.
Queue snapshots follow their uptime read non-atomically; displayed timestamp bounds bracket the uptime read, not the later queue read.
ps_observability: NOT_OBSERVABLE: mt7996_trace_mlo_ps excludes non-MLO stations; zero target P records cannot establish no PS transitions.

target_queue_ps_snapshots.scope: One non-atomic queue snapshot after the recorded uptime; repeated radio copies deduplicated.
